name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement failures and emits a single structured report of evidence-backed findings with prioritized, mechanism-sound fixes.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, runs the pipeline, composes every skill's findings into one schema-valid report.
Robots/sitemap/crawl/render. Produces the shared evidence snapshot and classifies site and page types.
Detects content a non-browser client cannot read: JS render gaps, facts locked in non-text, weak semantics.
Checks presence, validity, coverage, type-correctness and text-agreement of schema.org markup.
Checks whether a clear, self-contained fact can be quoted from a single retrieved chunk.
Checks off-site agreement on the brand's canonical claims and detects entity ambiguity.
Checks dating honesty, staleness markers, dead references and author attribution.
Checks whether a visitor arriving mid-funnel from an assistant orients, gets an answer and continues.
